title: Smaller Spike and logo images
summary: Public pages now load smaller Spike and logo pictures, so those images appear sooner without a visible drop in quality.
changes: Compressed and resized the public Spike welcome, tip, and dock pictures and the shared public logo.
affected_areas: Public landing, sign-in, and shared chrome
version_rationale: Patch release: shrinks existing public images without changing routes, sign-in, or page layout.
validation: PHPUnit HealthAndThemeTest and MascotHelperTest cover logo dimensions, srcset, and Spike image paths.
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
known_limitations: Other brand exports such as email and print logos are unchanged.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore the larger Spike and logo image files.
provenance: Compressed Spike and logo images for issue #127, pull request #208.
